Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of HD.
Operating income reached $2.4 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2022.
We delivered record revenue of $9.0 billion this quarter, representing 17% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 17% to 27% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.03 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
